proposal.summary: A use-after-free flaw in hfsplus_put_super (fs/hfsplus/super.c) allows a local user to cause a denial of service.
proposal.cwe_quote: A use-after-free flaw was found in hfsplus_put_super in fs/hfsplus/super.c in the Linux Kernel.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Investigate and patch the hfsplus_put_super use-after-free; verify kernel build and affected configurations; deploy patched kernel and monitor for resumption of service.

evidence_quotes.claim: flaw could allow a local user to cause a denial of service
evidence_quotes.quote: This flaw could allow a local user to cause a denial of service problem.
